newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss block planned speech by Peru rebel spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Swiss block planned speech by Peru rebel spokesman.

text.p: Swiss police on Friday banned Peruvian rebel spokesman Isaac Velazco from addressing a leftist May Day rally.

Velazco, European spokesman for the Peruvian rebel group Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA), was scheduled to speak at May 1 celebrations in Zurich. He was invited to attend by the "May 1 Committee," which traditionally seeks politically controversial speakers.
The Zurich aliens police, who oversee the movements of foreigners in the country, said the invitation to Velazco, who lives in Germany, would not be understood by many people.
The police said Velazco had spoken publicly about "reprisal attacks" after the storming of the Japanese embassy on April 22 in Lima to free 72 hostages.
A spokesman for the May 1 Committee in Zurich said that the police decision did not rule out Velazco visiting Switzerland during the celebrations.
